messages.author: b207b6a270f65efc
messages.subject: item parameters as fixed
parts:
HI Phil

I have some item parameters from another analysis and now i want to estimate ability for my sample based on those item parameters as fixed. which function in mirt can handle this problem?

messages.author: 71bfb5f1e96782a8
messages.subject: Re: item parameters as fixed
parts:
Hi Balal,

you can do the following:

parameters = mirt(Science, 1, pars = "values")

now you have a parameters table. set the values you like to fix to the respective value and set the respective est col to FALSE to prevent estimation of that specific parameter. than:

mirt(Science, 1, pars = parameters)

hth, felix
